Why referral program There’s no better sourcing channels that come from our own circle. Our employees know what would be the best match in term of skills, values and DNA of ELCA. Research has proven that referred candidates are of higher quality than applicants from the general public and are more likely both to receive and accept an offer, stay at the job longer and perform better. In a fast-growing company such as ELCA and in a very tight hiring market that we are facing, we need to encourage our employees to help us in bringing people with good references to fulfill the needs of recruitment. ELCA has decided to put in place referral program to: Broaden the scope of hiring and reach a larger number of people on the market  Shorten the recruitment process and lose less time in screening  On senior profiles we will reduce cost on hiring fees  Build strong team spirit and continue to build on strong values  Reduce our churn rate  Build on strengthening our employees’ engagement  © Copyright 2021 3 ELCA - The Independent Swiss IT Company
